long_description.title: The Ultimate Shredder’s V From Kramer
long_description.body: Ever since it was first introduced in 2008, the Kramer Nite-V has been embraced by many notable metal players, including Charlie Parra, Prika Amaral (Nervosa), and The Jasons. The Kramer Nite-V is the ultimate shredder’s V™, and its distinctive body carve makes it a very comfortable model to play when standing. The latest version of this manic metal machine features a mahogany body with string-through-body construction, a 14-degree angled headstock, locking tuners, a Graph Tech® nut, a thermally-aged maple neck with a K-Speed SlimTaper™ C-shaped profile outfitted with a bound ebony fretboard with Thorn inlays and jumbo frets, and a pair of Kramer USA-made Eruption pickups. A premium gig bag is also included. Pick one up today and rule the stage all Nite long!

Hardware Specs.Truss Rod Cover: Black Bullet with Nite-V in White 80s Kramer Font

Misc Specs.Headstock Inlay: Kramer Classic Logo in Silver Silkscreen
